svg.aria-label: The whole system drawn as a circle, its top edge the visible service. An experiment reaches down through it and opens a clear window onto one slice. Inside the window, interpretation, legislation, operations, decision rights and relationships, each joined to the others by a fine line, passing over and under where they cross. The rest of the circle is hatched, not looked at yet, with more materials faintly underneath.
svg.title: The whole system as a circle whose top edge is the visible service. An experiment reaches through it and opens a window onto one slice, where five materials and the relationships between them come into view. Hatching covers the rest of the system, where more materials lie unexamined
